summary_hint: Cancelled check #<number> from <drawer> to <borrower> for $<amount>, dated <check date>, cleared <cleared date> — evidences a $<note payment> installment for period <period>.

typed_core.name: drawer_or_maker_name
typed_core.why: identity — who paid the note (flattened from person_or_entity)

typed_core.name: drawer_bank_name
typed_core.why: identity/source — the paying bank

typed_core.name: drawer_account_last4
typed_core.why: PII (restricted, pre-masked) — the payer's account

typed_core.name: payee_or_borrower_name
typed_core.why: identity — the borrower receiving note income (flattened from person_or_entity)

typed_core.name: check_number
typed_core.why: identity — the check's unique reference; sequence tracking

typed_core.name: check_date
typed_core.why: processor — when written; matches the payment period

typed_core.name: check_amount_numeric
typed_core.why: processor — the received amount

typed_core.name: check_amount_written
typed_core.why: disambiguator — the written words confirm the numeric amount (misread protection)
typed_core.prompt_hint: Capture the written amount exactly — it is the legal amount

typed_core.name: memo_or_note_reference
typed_core.why: processor — ties the check to the specific note

typed_core.name: front_image_present
typed_core.why: processor — whether the front image is legible/present

typed_core.name: back_image_present
typed_core.why: processor — whether the endorsed back is present (proof of deposit)

typed_core.name: payee_endorsement
typed_core.why: processor — the endorsement confirms the borrower deposited it
typed_core.prompt_hint: Prioritize the back-of-check endorsement as proof of receipt

typed_core.name: deposit_account_last4
typed_core.why: PII (restricted, pre-masked) — the account the borrower deposited into

typed_core.name: bank_paid_or_cleared_stamp
typed_core.why: processor — the clearing stamp text proving the check paid

typed_core.name: cleared_date
typed_core.why: processor — the check actually cleared (not just written)

typed_core.name: deposit_or_posting_date
typed_core.why: processor — when deposited/posted

typed_core.name: return_stop_or_void_indicator
typed_core.why: processor — a returned/stopped/void check is not evidence of receipt

typed_core.name: statement_or_transaction_reference
typed_core.why: identity — ties the check to a bank-statement line

typed_core.name: related_note_date
typed_core.why: processor — links to the underlying note

typed_core.name: related_note_payment_amount
typed_core.why: processor/disambiguator — the required note payment to match against the check amount

typed_core.name: related_note_maturity_date
typed_core.why: processor — note still active / income continues

typed_core.name: payment_period_start
typed_core.why: processor — which installment period this check covers (flattened from date_range)

typed_core.name: payment_period_end
typed_core.why: processor — period end (flattened from date_range)

rejected.name: sequential_payment_history
rejected.reason: TECHNICAL/derived position — a conclusion computed across checks; tags describe, rules judge

rejected.name: party_names / party_addresses
rejected.reason: generic; superseded by typed drawer/payee names

rejected.name: issuer_name, issuer_address, issuer_phone, issuer_email_or_url, form_number, form_revision_date
rejected.reason: a check is self-identifying via drawer/bank/check number

rejected.name: document_title, document_status_or_version, signature_blocks, notary_block
rejected.reason: the endorsement (payee_endorsement) is the relevant execution mark

encoding_variations: The amount appears twice: numeric (courtesy amount) and written (legal amount). Keep both — check_amount_written is the disambiguator when the numeric field is smudged or altered.

'Cleared' is evidenced variously: a bank paid/cleared stamp, a posting date, or an endorsement on the back; keep bank_paid_or_cleared_stamp, cleared_date, and back_image_present so a reviewer can confirm the check truly paid rather than was merely written.
The check date, deposit date, and cleared date differ — keep them distinct.

open_questions.q: One check vs a bundle — packets often bundle multiple cancelled checks.
options: single-check schema + splitter emits one extraction per check
open_questions.recommendation: keep the schema single-check and rely on the splitter to emit one extraction per check; only introduce a nested checks[] list if the pipeline cannot split and a rule needs all checks in one record. Flag the splitter behavior with the domain expert

open_questions.q: Boolean degradation — front_image_present, back_image_present, and return_stop_or_void_indicator degrade to strings.
open_questions.recommendation: accept and rely on the snippet; the returned/void flag is the one most likely to need a typed boolean if a rule is built

notes: No rules read this document today, so there is no rule floor. A cancelled check proves the borrower actually received a note/installment payment; fields earn their place on identity, PII protection (masked account last-4s), and processor review.
Both drawer_account_last4 and deposit_account_last4 are pre_masked true and need _PII_FIELDS registration.
Endorsement text may contain a full account number written by hand; the model must mask it — do not file a full account number to the catch-all.

Prompt hint (doc-level): the purpose is proving receipt of note income, not just that a check was written. Prioritize the back-of-check endorsement, the deposit account, and the clearing/paid evidence. Comparing check_amount_numeric against related_note_payment_amount is a downstream check — capture both verbatim, do not judge whether they match. Mask account numbers to last-4.
